gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of GBM according to WHO classification criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] TTFields: TTFields treatment will consist of wearing four electrically insulated electrode arrays on the head.
Concurrent brain directed antitumor therapy or procedures beyond TTFields is prohibited.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Open-Label Pilot Study of OPTUNE® With High Density Transducer Arrays for the Treatment of Recurrent GBM

coder_notes: Device-only trial (TTFields with high-intensity arrays); no drug or biologic intervention. Coded no_pharmacological_candidate; excluded_intervention_type would be an alternative reading since devices appear in the manual's excluded-types list, but no agent row exists. 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' terminology = historical.
